data.summary: AI engineer who builds AI infrastructure, not just AI features. Built a token-metering and LLM observability platform from scratch; prompt caching cut LLM token costs ~90%. 6 years in production software, the last 2+ on AI/LLM systems: RAG, agentic workflows (LangChain, LangGraph), multimodal document intelligence (YOLOv11 + Vision LLMs), Text-to-SQL, and event-driven architecture, serving 1,000+ users across 10 enterprise tenants on GCP. Leads 5 engineers across Python, FastAPI, Java, Node.js, and React.

evidence.proof: Built a token-metering and LLM observability platform from scratch, replacing Langfuse; request-level tracing, audit trails, five-tier request pricing; prompt caching cut LLM token cost ~90%.
LangChain/LangGraph + Gemini agent with human-in-the-loop review, automating inspection creation; research effort -30%.
Text-to-SQL engine from scratch with schema-grounded RAG and guardrails against destructive SQL and cross-tenant leakage; 75% accuracy across 200+ schemas.
Architected a Gemini vision-LLM extraction pipeline, 90% field-level accuracy; page images via GCS to a React UI.
Trained a custom YOLOv11 document-layout model in PyTorch (2,500+ annotated images, 80% mAP@0.5) and deployed it on Google Cloud Run.
Notification service on PostgreSQL WAL-based CDC; a Mistral LLM classifies and prioritizes events; alerts to 1,000+ users within 20s over WebSockets.
Re-architected a legacy monolith into a multi-tenant SaaS (Node.js, MongoDB), 10 isolated enterprise tenants; Java/React SSO (enterprise IdP + OTP); +20% throughput, 40% faster login.
React UIs for all of the above; earlier shipped a MERN real-time messaging platform (WebSockets, JWT) for 1,000+ users and a Jest-tested React rich-text editor reused across 7 products.
Lead engineer for the team's AI systems; owns architecture and end-to-end delivery, drives build-vs-buy decisions via RFCs, mentors 5 engineers.
GCP (Cloud Run, GCS), Docker, CI/CD, Git. No AWS, Azure or Kubernetes in production.

CryptoLens - RAG agent over 2,000+ YouTube transcripts; BGE-M3 embeddings in Qdrant, hybrid search with temporal reranking, contradiction detection, citation-grounded answers (Groq Llama 3.3 70B + Gemini).

unproven: formal LLM evaluation pipelines / eval harnesses
high-traffic consumer scale (largest stated scale is 1,000+ users, 10 tenants)
people management (leads and mentors, no direct reports stated)
